records.subject: spec-guard-0.58.0-codex-copy
evidence: result:all run green from the installed copy (phase-guard 284 cases, verify-artifacts 52 cases, project link 18 tests)
command:PLUGIN_ROOT=x /bin/bash <installed>/hooks/phase-guard.sh </dev/null, run from a session directory whose link names a directory without the convention
result:one diagnostic line says the linked directory has not enabled spec-guard and points to link-project; no stage is printed

records.subject: spec-guard-0.58.0-codex-linked-session
evidence: command:python3 -B <installed>/hooks/project_link.py set --from <session dir> --project ../code-repo --confirm, in a temporary layout: a session directory with no convention (its name carries a space) and an enabled project beside it
command:codex exec --skip-git-repo-check from the session directory, with the installed plugin (no hook-trust bypass)
result:exit 0; the session copied its injection verbatim: the Linked project line naming the project and the session directory, and "当前阶段: **NEEDS_PLAN**" -- the linked project's stage
command:python3 -B <installed>/hooks/project_link.py unset --from <session dir> --confirm, then codex exec again
result:the session answered that it had no spec-guard injection; ~/.codex/config.toml is byte-identical before and after the runs
